sections.title: باب 1 — متن (9)

paras.text: … a diet plan has been given for heart patients. By acting on it heart patients and other people too can spend a healthy life.
paras.urdu: دل کے مریضوں کے لیے غذائی پلان دیا گیا ہے۔ ان پر عمل کر کے دل کے مریض اور دیگر افراد بھی صحت مند زندگی گزار سکتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: … د زړه ناروغانو لپاره غذايي پلان ورکړل شوی. پر هغه په عمل سره د زړه ناروغان او نور کسان هم روغ ژوند تېرولی شي.

paras.text: Blood pressure patients should reduce the use of salt.
paras.urdu: بلڈ پریشر کے مریض نمک کا استعمال کم کریں۔
paras.pashto: د وینې فشار ناروغان دې د مالګې کارول کم کړي.

paras.text: Heart patients should always take food less than their hunger and rest for half an hour after eating.
paras.urdu: دل کے مریض کھانا ہمیشہ بھوک سے کم لیں اور کھانا کھانے کے بعد آدھا گھنٹہ آرام کریں۔
paras.pashto: د زړه ناروغان دې تل له لوږې کم خواړه وخوري او له خوړلو وروسته نیم ساعت استراحت وکړي.

sections.content:
… a diet plan has been given for heart patients. By acting on it heart patients and other people too can spend a healthy life.

Note:

Blood pressure patients should reduce the use of salt.

Heart patients should always take food less than their hunger and rest for half an hour after eating.

rows: Meat: 6 ounces daily
Meat without fat, after removing the skin (chicken or goat), which is not fried
Fish, chicken roasted or in curry (low fat)
Egg yolk, fatty meat, beef, head and trotters, brain, kidneys, liver etc.
Milk
Milk without cream and fat
☆ One glass of milk without cream; yoghurt made from it; buttermilk lassi
Milk with cream, cream, yoghurt, cheese etc.
Eggs
Egg white
☆ Egg white daily; once or twice a week an egg with the yolk
Paratha, fatty foods
Oil: three teaspoons in a day
Maize, olive, canola, sunflower, sesame, soya bean; bread, rice, biscuits without cream, home-made cake rusk
☆ Olive / groundnut oil ☆ Walnut, almond, dried fig ☆ Rusk, brown bread
Coconut, palm oil, butter, desi ghee, ghee of any kind; bakery items, doughnuts, cream items; cheese, rice (biryani)
Bread etc.
Noodles, dried peas, beans, simple steamed potatoes
☆ Home-made bread ☆ Food cooked in cooking oil.
Fatty and salty foods
Fruits and vegetables
Fresh fruit, dried fruit closed in tins, canned fruit with little syrup
☆ Fresh fruit, fresh vegetables, salad ☆ Sugar patients can eat less sweet fruits. ☆ Boiled vegetables, all pulses
Coconut, ice cream, chocolate, chips, pizza etc.
